question: What is the cost of the ‘Nand Baba Milk Mission’ scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh state government in 2023 to provide milk producers the facility of selling their milk at a reasonable price in villages through dairy co-operative societies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Uttar Pradesh government launched the 'Nand Baba Milk Mission' scheme in 2023.
 
• The scheme is aimed at providing milk producers in villages the facility to sell their milk at a reasonable price through dairy co-operative societies.
 
• The total cost of the 'Nand Baba Milk Mission' scheme is ₹1,000 crore.
 
• This initiative is expected to benefit milk producers by ensuring fair pricing and improving their income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dairy Co-operative Societies**

 
 
• Dairy co-operative societies are organizations formed by milk producers to collectively market their milk and milk products.
 
• They help in providing a stable market for milk producers and ensure that they get fair prices for their products.
 
• These societies also provide various services such as veterinary care, feed supply, and training to the members.
 
 
 
• **Milk Pricing**
 
 
• Milk pricing is crucial for the sustainability of milk producers. Fair pricing ensures that producers can cover their costs and make a reasonable profit.
 
• Various factors like quality, fat content, and market demand influence the price of milk.
 
• Government schemes like the 'Nand Baba Milk Mission' aim to stabilize milk prices and protect producers from market fluctuations.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Rural Economy**
 
 
• Milk production is a significant source of livelihood for many rural families.
 
• Providing a stable and fair market for milk can improve the economic conditions of rural areas.
 
• It can also contribute to the overall development of the agricultural sector and increase rural incomes.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives in the Dairy Sector**
 
 
• Various government schemes aim to support the dairy sector, such as the National Dairy Plan and Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme.
 
• These initiatives focus on increasing milk production, improving quality, and providing financial support to dairy farmers.
 
• They also aim to enhance the infrastructure for milk collection, processing, and marketing.
